source_caption:
To authentically capture the terrifying, isolating experience of sudden, severe hearing loss, director Darius Marder went to extreme lengths to physically alter Riz Ahmed’s sensory perception during filming. Instead of simply asking Ahmed to act deaf, Marder had custom auditory blockers placed deep inside the actor’s ear canals. These specialized earpieces emitted a constant, high-frequency white noise that genuinely deafened Ahmed during takes, completely preventing him from hearing his own voice, the environment, or his co-stars. This intense, immersive technique ensured that Ruben’s on-screen panic, communication struggles, and profound sense of sudden isolation were rooted in a very real, visceral reality rather than simulated acting.

Sound of Metal (2019), directed by Darius Marder, starring Riz Ahmed, Olivia Cooke, Paul Raci, Lauren Ridloff. A passionate heavy metal drummer’s life is thrown into a sudden, terrifying freefall when he begins to rapidly lose his hearing, forcing him to navigate a new silent reality, confront his past addictions, and ultimately redefine his entire identity.

source_details.title: Sound of Metal
source_details.synopsis: Sound of Metal is a 2019 American drama film directed by Darius Marder, who co-wrote the story with Derek Cianfrance before co-writing the screenplay with his brother Abraham Marder. It stars Riz Ahmed as a metal drummer who loses his hearing. The cast also includes Olivia Cooke, Paul Raci, Lauren Ridloff, and Mathieu Amalric. Sound of Metal had its world premiere in the Platform Prize program at the 2019 Toronto International Film Festival on September 6, 2019. Amazon Studios released the film in theaters on November 20, 2020, and on Amazon Prime Video on December 4.
